topic: Demonstration and explanation on the correct procedures of connecting the towing arm to A/C and tractor and movement of aircraft with proper positioning of safety numbers and choke man i.a.w INAP 2 article
syllabus_extract: Demonstration and explanation on the correct procedures of connecting the towing arm to A/C and tractor and movement of aircraft with proper positioning of safety numbers and choke man i.a.w INAP 2 article
specific_objectives: 29.1.1.8 Trainee will be able to explain procedure on movement of A/C from hangar to dispersal

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of towing arm connection, safety number placement, and choke man positioning under instructor supervision
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of the towing arm?
Where are the safety numbers located on the towing arm?
What is the role of the choke man during aircraft movement?

development.content:
Pre-towing safety checks
Towing arm connection procedure
Safety number positioning
Choke man duties

Aircraft movement initiation
Communication signals
Emergency stop procedures

Post-movement safety checks
Dispersal area positioning
Documentation requirements

summary_questions: Explain the correct sequence for connecting the towing arm.
Describe the responsibilities of the choke man during towing.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the GSEs required for flying activity and flight servicing as covered in LP 09.

pft_rows.syllabus: Demonstration and explanation on the various GSEs required on dispersal for flying activity and flight servicing. (a) GSE maintenance. Schedule & record of inspections carried out (b) Calibration of GSE (as applicable) and record of calibration.
